name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx as a multi-site web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including site configuration, document roots, certificates, and related host security controls.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and a single Redis server, including Redis authentication, runtime paths, logging, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs a Python FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, configures its virtual environment and dependencies, provisions PostgreSQL, and runs the application under systemd.
